rubric.role_summary: Early full-stack product engineering role building AI-powered media monitoring and analytics tools, with responsibility for architecture, production delivery, and technical direction.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Early full-stack product engineering role building AI-powered media monitoring and analytics tools, with responsibility for architecture, production delivery, and technical direction.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- 2+ years of relevant engineering experience at tech and product-driven companies.
- Proficiency with web technologies; the named technologies are examples, not an all-technologies requirement.
- Deep knowledge and practical experience with cloud-based services, containerization, and API development.
Explicit disqualifiers:
- Background primarily in firmware, embedded systems, hardware engineering, networking, or infrastructure/DevOps is described as probably not the right fit.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Experience with LLM fine-tuning, RAG, RLHF, or eval pipelines.
- Computer vision or multimodal model experience involving audio, video, or image.
- Experience with semantic search, vector databases, or meaning-aware retrieval.
- Familiarity with web scraping frameworks and different types of API integrations.
- Comfort with asynchronous workflows, rate-limiting, and distributed systems.
- Startup founder or early-stage experience.
- Experience taking systems from zero to production and owning their full lifecycle.
- Experience optimizing data architectures for performance and cost.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Accept any one of these geographic alternatives (OR): United States. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them. Remote candidates must currently be located in one of these areas; remote work does not remove this geographic condition.
